KPMG Report: Productivity to Drive 35% of India's Future Manufacturing Output

A report by KPMG indicates that productivity improvements will account for 35% of India's future manufacturing output. The report highlights that companies focusing on productivity achieved over 50% higher profitability growth and doubled their market capitalization compared to their peers. These productivity gains are projected to be a significant driver for the nation's manufacturing sector.
